method.backend: Metal + Accelerate, CGO_ENABLED=1, tags metal coreml, eight workers
method.short: 64 tokens/steps. Ministral: 27-token prompt, fully cached for warm requests, temperature0, seed41, repeat penalty1.1. Voxtral: full real weights including prepared encoder, 32 teacher-forced embedding inputs then64 fixed embedding inputs with vocabulary selection. No audio encoding/transcription latency measured. First repetition per process excluded from warm summary.
method.ordering: Ministral: baseline/final, final/baseline, two processes per variant. Voxtral: two balanced sets, four processes per variant; second set uses reviewed growth implementation.
method.long: Four uncached 64-token requests per process. Repeated memory text expands prompt beyond512MiB reusable KV budget:2552/1670 prompt tokens. runtime.GC after every request and before heap snapshots; no forced OS scavenging. Identical control/final token digests.
method.retention_control: Same candidate code/harness, Go overlay removes only the two deferred transient-cache cleanup calls; exact patch below.
method.sampling: 0.5s plus command overhead. Preserve every RSS sample and swap/page-in/compression counters; initial/final full VM snapshots retained. Full capture SHA256 supplied.
method.limits: Process RSS does not account for all GPU/unified driver memory; Go live heap after GC is not RSS. System VM counters include other apps. About4.9GiB swap occupied before work; Xcode/Chromium active. No file-cache purge; first requests are process-cold, not guaranteed cold SSD. No sustained whole-model decoding speedup established.

post_measurement_review: GrowCache now replaces buffers layer by layer and includes final compaction headroom in the last doubling, avoiding a two-full-cache memory peak. Earlier short-context runs never exceeded256positions; second Voxtral balanced set uses this reviewed version. Ministral does not call GrowCache. Native/portable and growth parity tests pass.
